dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, what do your parents do?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt duː jʊr ˈpɛrənts ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My mom and dad are teachers. They work in a school in Bangkok.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈmɑːm ənd ˈdæd ər ˈtiːtʃərz. ðeɪ ˈwɜːrk ɪn ə ˈskuːl ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And your aunt in Chiang Mai? What does she do?
dialogue.reading: ənd jʊr ˈænt ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ? ˈwʌt dʌz ʃiː ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She works as a lawyer for a big company.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈwɜːrks əz ə ˈlɔːjər fər ə ˈbɪɡ ˈkʌmpəni.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: He works as an accountant in a factory.
dialogue.reading: hiː ˈwɜːrks əz ən əˈkaʊntənt ɪn ə ˈfæktəri.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What do they make in the factory?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt duː ðeɪ ˈmeɪk ɪn ðə ˈfæktəri?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Shoes! He always gives me shoes!
dialogue.reading: ˈʃuːz! hiː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈɡɪvz miː ˈʃuːz!
